sloka: काञ्चनीं मम पत्नीं च दीक्षायां ज्ञांश्च कर्मणि ।अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे महायशाः ।। ७.९१.२५ ॥
transliteration: kāñcanīṁ mama patnīṁ ca dīkṣāyāṁ jñāṁśca karmaṇi ।agrato bharataḥ kṛtvā gacchatvagre mahāyaśāḥ ।। 7.91.25 ॥

translations.english: Rama commanded that the greatly renowned Bharata should proceed first, carrying his golden idol of Sita, who represented his wife for the initiation, and also leading those who were knowledgeable in the rituals.
